summary.zh: 搭建与排查数据管道、ETL 与批处理任务
summary.en: Build and debug Airflow, Spark, dbt and Kafka pipelines

description.zh: 覆盖 Airflow DAG、Spark 作业、dbt 模型与 Kafka 消费链路的设计和排错。任务超时、数据落错或需要新建入仓流程时使用，同时给出数据质量校验与安全重跑方案。
description.en: Designs and debugs Airflow DAGs, Spark jobs, dbt models and Kafka consumers. Use it when a batch job times out or fails, data lands wrong, or you need a new ingestion path with quality checks and safe reruns.
